Name: HA
Segments:
- Lead high-availability and disaster-recovery (HA/DR) design, including backup, failover, and recovery procedures, to meet client and contractual uptime commitments.

Segments:

Name: IB
Segments:
- The Portfolio ranges from Programme of Work (POW) activities funded via the NATO Military Budget (MB) to Critical / Urgent Requirements (CURs/URs) and NATO Security Investment Programme (NSIP) projects funded via the Investment Budget(IB).
- Live positioning against the threat intelligence, DRP, EASM and exposure management field: Recorded Future, ZeroFox, Flashpoint, Cyble, Group-IB, Check Point/Cyberint, Searchlight Cyber, Silent Push, Doppel, and the ratings vendors (Bitsight, SecurityScorecard) where SVigil competes
